_about: LTEC's house thresholds for the oil & gas quick checks (#46), rated per case by oil_gas.quick_checks = quickChecks in oil_gas.js, the same green / amber / red rules as engine/screens.json. A deal overrides a check in its `screens` {id: {green, amber, source}}. Missing data reads n/a.

checks.label: Sponsor's load over the operator's cost (AFE)
checks.why: What the investor pays above its share of the operator's well costs: commissions, fees and the turnkey margin. Industry programs typically run 10-20%.

checks.label: Multiple on money in
checks.why: Wells deplete: there is no sale at the end, so the multiple has to cover the risk on its own.

checks.label: Payback (years)
checks.why: Steep early decline means most cash comes early; a long payback leaves the capital exposed to prices and decline for years.

checks.label: PV10 per dollar in
checks.why: The industry's standard value of future net cash (discounted at 10%); below 1.0 the price paid exceeds that value.

checks.label: After-tax IRR
checks.why: The pitch rests on the deduction; this is the return with it, at the case's tax treatment.

checks.label: Cash in the first 12 months, share of money in
checks.why: New horizontal wells should return a large share early; a low figure means the production claims are not holding up.
